subject: Nanotechnology
title: The National Nanotechnology Initiative
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The National Nanotechnology Initiative.

hook.text: In 2000, President Clinton announced a $500 million federal bet on nanotechnology.

buildup.text: The National Nanotechnology Initiative coordinated research across twenty federal agencies.

discovery.text: The NNI funded basic research, built shared facilities, and trained a generation of nanoscientists.

twist.text: Critics called it overhyped — but its investments quietly seeded breakthroughs in medicine and chips.

climax.text: By 2024, cumulative NNI funding exceeded $40 billion — the largest science push since Apollo.

punchline.text: A government bet on the tiny paid off enormously.

quiz.question: What was the National Nanotechnology Initiative?
options: A coordinated U.S. federal research investment in nanotechnology
A United Nations treaty regulating nanomaterials
